title: Human Intelligence Platform — Personal and Enterprise Digital Twin Reference Architecture

platform.name: Human Intelligence Platform
platform.thesis: A Human-in-the-Loop Digital Twin platform where people and organizations manage governed digital representations to achieve measurable progress.
platform.system_boundary: The platform manages Personal Digital Twins, Enterprise Digital Twins and authorized relationships between them.

personal_digital_twin.purpose: Represent and help manage the person's evolving identity, state, capabilities, goals, relationships and outcomes.

enterprise_digital_twin.purpose: Represent and help manage the organization's structure, people, assets, processes, ecosystem, risks and outcomes.

authorized_relationship_layer.purpose: Represent governed relationships between Personal and Enterprise Digital Twins without merging their identities or ownership.

ownership_rules: A Personal Digital Twin is controlled by the person subject to applicable law and agreements.
An Enterprise Digital Twin is controlled by the enterprise or authorized organization.
A relationship record has its own owner, purpose, permissions and validity period.
Enterprise ownership does not imply ownership of a person's complete Personal Digital Twin.
Personal consent does not grant unrestricted access to enterprise internal data.

distinction_from_profile_system.profile_system: Stores descriptive attributes about a user or organization.
distinction_from_profile_system.digital_twin: Maintains a time-aware, evidence-linked and governed model of an entity's state, goals, relationships, transitions, actions and outcomes.
required_proof_for_twin_claim: state can be updated by events
claims link to evidence or provenance
the model supports a decision or operational workflow

mvp_boundary.rule: Implement one bounded vertical slice before building the full platform.
mvp_boundary.personal_first_candidate: Learning and Capabilities view for a student
mvp_boundary.enterprise_first_candidate: To be validated; no enterprise buyer or use case is selected.

promotion_requires: updated file inventory and memory routing
